title: Deborah
lines: Deborah was a judge of Israel and a prophet of God.
底波拉是以色列的士師，也是神的先知。
It was her job to lead the Israelites in the way God wanted, and to tell the people what God wanted her to say.
她的職責是照神的心意帶領以色列人，並把神要她說的話告訴百姓。
She would sit under a palm tree, and the Israelites would come up to her so she could help them make a decision when they didn't know what to do.
她常坐在一棵棕樹下，以色列人不知道該怎麼辦時，就上她那裡去，請她幫忙做決定。
There was a commander named Sisera, who was in charge of the army of Canaan, who were enemies of Israel.
有一位將軍名叫西西拉，他統領迦南的軍隊，迦南人是以色列的仇敵。
Sisera and his army treated the Israelites very badly for twenty years.
西西拉和他的軍隊欺壓以色列人二十年。
So the Israelites cried out to the Lord for help.
以色列人就呼求耶和華幫助。
Deborah sent for a man named Barak and said, "The Lord, the God of Israel, is giving you a command."
底波拉派人叫一個名叫巴拉的人來，對他說：「耶和華以色列的神吩咐你。」
"He says, 'Go, take ten thousand men from the tribes of Naphtali and Zebulun with you.'"
「祂說：『你要從拿弗他利和西布倫支派中率領一萬人。』」
"'Then lead them up to Mount Tabor.'"
"'I will lead Sisera into a trap. There I will hand him over to you.'"
「『我必使西西拉落入圈套，把他交在你手中。』」
Barak said to her, "If you go with me, I'll go. But if you don't go with me, I won't go."
巴拉對她說：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」
"But because of the way you are doing this, you won't receive any honor."
「只是你這樣做，就得不著榮耀。」
"Instead, the Lord will hand Sisera over to a woman."
「因為耶和華要把西西拉交在一個婦人手裡。」
So Barak gathered the army God commanded, and Deborah also went with him.
巴拉就照神的吩咐召集軍隊，底波拉也與他同去。
Sisera gathered together his nine hundred chariots and all his men.
西西拉召集了他的九百輛鐵車和全軍。
Then Deborah said to Barak, "Go! Today the Lord will hand Sisera over to you. Hasn't the Lord gone ahead of you?"
底波拉對巴拉說：「起來！今日就是耶和華把西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和華豈不在你前頭行嗎？」
So Barak and his men marched out, and the Lord drove Sisera away from the battlefield.
巴拉就帶著軍隊出征，耶和華使西西拉從戰場上潰逃。
All of Sisera's army was defeated, but Sisera ran away on foot to the tent of a woman named Jael.
西西拉的全軍都被打敗了，西西拉卻徒步逃到一個名叫雅億的婦人的帳棚。
Jael brought Sisera into her tent.
雅億把西西拉迎進帳棚。
He thought she was helping him, but she quietly defeated him as he slept.
他以為她在幫他，她卻趁他熟睡時悄悄打敗了他。
Barak came and saw that what God told Deborah had happened, and Sisera had been defeated by a woman.
巴拉趕到，看見神對底波拉說的話應驗了：西西拉被一個婦人打敗。
On that day, God brought Canaan under Israel's control.
那一日，神使迦南人被以色列人制伏。
Deborah and Barak sang a song praising God for what he had done.
底波拉和巴拉唱歌讚美神所做的事。
And Israel was at peace again for forty years.
以色列又太平了四十年。
